about: Register of the Star Citizen builds the game pack's signature rows were checked against, oldest first. Public facts only: the patch name, the four-part file version and changelist the launcher and build_manifest.id show, dates, the game pack and SDK releases pinned to each build, and which rows changed from the previous build. tools/release_docs.py renders docs/game/builds.md from this file and refuses a verified build (SCO_GAME_PACK_VERIFIED_BUILD) that is not the newest entry here.

builds.name_note: A deployment log lists 4.10.1-live.12660092; one patch summary gives 12650677 instead.
changes: The first build the signature rows were written against, before the game pack recorded a verified build.

`teleport.to_camera`: the four camera fields its handler loads moved by 8 bytes. The row's checks now pin the instructions and wildcard the field offset (SDK 1.1.0); it resolves on 4.10.193 and 4.10.196.
The first build recorded as the game pack's verified build.

builds.name_note: Hotfix of 4.10.2; the patch name stayed 4.10.2.
changes: No signature row moved: every row resolved in a static `sco-sigcheck` run (317/317). The launcher and CrashHandler are byte-identical to 4.10.196.36804.

builds.name_note: Launcher build string 4.10.3-LIVE.13165946. The game reports branch sc-alpha-4.10.0 and file version 4.10.200.58746.
changes: Five rows changed layout and were re-anchored, each with a bounds test: ATC clear token, hauling assignment, restricted-area impound and the two quantum action rows. Their updated locators also resolve on 4.10.197.2878.
Every row resolved in a static `sco-sigcheck` run (347/347). Every other row gives the same result as before on the synthetic parity fixtures (`tests/issue302_valid_parity.py`).
Hauling semantics on this build are not verified.
